faqs.q: What is the Dynamic Fluid Components BMER Orbital Motors, Magneto Mount, 1 1/4" Keyed Shaft and what is it used for?
faqs.a: The Dynamic Fluid Components BMER Orbital Motors, Magneto Mount, 1 1/4" Keyed Shaft is a low-speed, high-torque orbital hydraulic motor, listed in 25 part numbers with displacement 118 to 745 cm³/rev. Orbital motors suit machine drives that need torque at low shaft speed, and displacement sets the trade between speed and torque. The mounting is 6-Hole Magneto.

faqs.q: How do I identify the part number of the Dynamic Fluid Components BMER Orbital Motors, Magneto Mount, 1 1/4" Keyed Shaft?
faqs.a: Quote the part number from the motor nameplate, which carries the model code. For example BMER-2-125-FS-G2-S (118 cm³/rev, 1.25" Keyed shaft, 6-Hole Magneto mount, SAE-10 ports, 2,973 psi continuous) and BMER-2-750-FS-G2-S-R (745 cm³/rev, 1.25" Keyed shaft, 6-Hole Magneto mount, SAE-10 ports, 1,523 psi continuous) are two of the 25 rows. The size table gives the displacement, shaft and port details for each part number.

faqs.q: What displacement range does the Dynamic Fluid Components BMER Orbital Motors, Magneto Mount, 1 1/4" Keyed Shaft cover?
faqs.a: The Dynamic Fluid Components BMER Orbital Motors, Magneto Mount, 1 1/4" Keyed Shaft spans 118 to 745 cm³/rev across 25 part numbers. That is 13 distinct displacements. A larger displacement turns slower with more torque for a given flow, and shaft speed in rpm is roughly flow in US gpm × 231 ÷ displacement in in³/rev, before volumetric losses.

faqs.q: Which shaft options does the Dynamic Fluid Components BMER Orbital Motors, Magneto Mount, 1 1/4" Keyed Shaft offer?
faqs.a: The shaft options on the Dynamic Fluid Components BMER Orbital Motors, Magneto Mount, 1 1/4" Keyed Shaft are 1.25" Keyed. Match the shaft to the machine, because keyed, spline and tapered shafts do not interchange. Give us the shaft type and diameter from your old motor, and the part number if you have it.

faqs.q: What pressure, speed and torque ratings does the Dynamic Fluid Components BMER Orbital Motors, Magneto Mount, 1 1/4" Keyed Shaft have?
faqs.a: The Dynamic Fluid Components BMER Orbital Motors, Magneto Mount, 1 1/4" Keyed Shaft lists these ratings by part number. Continuous pressure runs 1,523 to 2,973 psi. Intermittent or maximum pressure runs 1,740 to 3,481 psi. Torque runs 3,363 to 11,063 lb-in. Maximum speed runs 120 to 490 rpm. Rated flow runs 14 to 19.81 US gpm. Ratings vary by size, so read the row for the part number you order, and size the motor on the continuous figures, treating intermittent figures as short peaks only.

faqs.q: What mounting and port options does the Dynamic Fluid Components BMER Orbital Motors, Magneto Mount, 1 1/4" Keyed Shaft have?
faqs.a: The mounting of the Dynamic Fluid Components BMER Orbital Motors, Magneto Mount, 1 1/4" Keyed Shaft is 6-Hole Magneto, and the ports are SAE-10. Match the mount, shaft and ports to the motor you are replacing, and quote the part number from its nameplate where you can.

faqs.q: Which standards does the Dynamic Fluid Components BMER Orbital Motors, Magneto Mount, 1 1/4" Keyed Shaft follow?
faqs.a: The Dynamic Fluid Components BMER Orbital Motors, Magneto Mount, 1 1/4" Keyed Shaft names an SAE mounting flange, 6-Hole Magneto, which refers to the SAE J744 flange pattern. The ports are SAE-10. Confirm the flange size and the port type against your machine before ordering.

faqs.q: What do I connect to the Dynamic Fluid Components BMER Orbital Motors, Magneto Mount, 1 1/4" Keyed Shaft?
faqs.a: Hose or tube connects to the ports, SAE-10, and the load fits on the shaft, 1.25" Keyed. For sizing hose and fittings to the flow see the [motor torque and speed guide](/blog/hydraulic-motor-torque-and-speed). Other orbital motors are on the [orbital motors shelf](/c/orbital-hydraulic-motors).

faqs.q: How do I install and run the Dynamic Fluid Components BMER Orbital Motors, Magneto Mount, 1 1/4" Keyed Shaft?
faqs.a: For the Dynamic Fluid Components BMER Orbital Motors, Magneto Mount, 1 1/4" Keyed Shaft, tell us the circuit pressure and flow so we confirm the part. Check the shaft alignment, keep the system clean and fill the motor with oil before running it.

faqs.q: Which machines use the Dynamic Fluid Components BMER Orbital Motors, Magneto Mount, 1 1/4" Keyed Shaft?

The Dynamic Fluid Components BMER Orbital Motors, Magneto Mount, 1 1/4" Keyed Shaft is listed with 6-Hole Magneto mounting.
